row.scim_price_text: Not disclosed (controlled availability; contact Five9 representative)
row.evidence: Five9 Identity Service documents SCIM-based Automated User Management (create, deactivate, update users; IdP groups become Circles), but the docs say it is 'currently in controlled availability. Contact your Five9 representative', and no plan or price for it is published.
row.notes: New row. SCIM exists (Five9 Identity Service Automated User Management, SCIM 2.0 with a Five9 extension schema, bearer API key from API Access Control with scope scim:write) but is in controlled availability and not tied to any bundle on the pricing page, so the price gate is not disclosed: status unknown rather than gated. Pricing page lists Digital $119 and Core $159 per concurrent seat per month (billing term not stated, minimum 50 seats) and Plus, Pro and Enterprise as Contact Sales. Okta's catalogue 'Five9' app is SWA only and Entra's gallery app is SSO only; Five9's guides use the generic Okta SCIM 2.0 app and Entra non-gallery provisioning. SAML SSO is in Five9 Identity Service, plan not stated. User admin API is the SOAP Configuration Web Services, whose reference sits behind a login.

scim.notes: Automated User Management (SCIM) is part of Five9 Identity Service and is in controlled availability: it must be enabled by a Five9 representative, as must the API Access Control panel that issues the SCIM key. No plan or price is attached to it on the pricing page or in the docs. The base URL is generated per SCIM policy in Admin Console; its pattern is not published.

auth.token_source: Admin Console > API Access Control > API Key (predefined scope scim:write)
auth.token_expiry: Never Expires or a custom duration (admin's choice)

operations.notes: Docs say users are created, deactivated and updated from the IdP and that the active flag deactivates/reactivates; PUT vs PATCH is not stated, so update is recorded only in scim_ops.update.

custom.how: Five9 extension namespace urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:five9:2.0:User with employeeId, idpFederationId, costCenter, domainName, domainUsername

roles.how: IdP groups are pushed and become Five9 Circles, which carry permission sets, applications, skills and other user properties

limitations.text: Controlled availability only: Automated User Management and the API Access Control panel must be enabled by a Five9 representative.
Managed users must use SSO authentication and have a Federation ID; the SCIM policy must be tied to a (non-legacy) Five9 Identity Service SSO policy.
Users whose federation ID already exists are skipped, not recreated.
Okta setup uses the generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' rather than a Five9 catalogue app.

user_api.notes: User administration over API is via the legacy SOAP Configuration Web Services, reached by API Only users. The Configuration Web Services API reference (documentation.five9.com/bundle/config-webservices-api-reference-guide) redirected to a login page, so methods, plan and limits could not be verified.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Documented in the Event Subscription Service (ESS) event schema; how customers subscribe was not checked.

okta.notes: OIN 'Five9' app is checked only for SWA (read from page markup). Five9's own Okta guide provisions through the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App instead.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Five9 Plus Adapter (CTI, Contact Center Agents)' is SAML SSO only; Five9's guide turns on automatic provisioning on the customer's own Five9 SSO app with the SCIM policy base URL and API key.

open_questions: Which Five9 bundles (Digital, Core, Plus, Pro, Enterprise) can have Automated User Management (SCIM) enabled, and whether it costs extra, is not published.
The SCIM base URL pattern, supported endpoints (ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, Bulk), PUT vs PATCH, filtering, pagination and rate limits are not documented publicly.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees the Five9 user licence or ends sessions, and whether SCIM DELETE is supported, is not documented.
Which plans include SAML SSO through Five9 Identity Service is not stated.
Whether the pricing page's per-seat prices are monthly or annual-term is not stated.
The SOAP Configuration Web Services user methods, plan and limits sit behind a login.
No audit-log API was found; the configuration events log is exported as CSV.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue entries were not verified (JumpCloud page returned 403).
